# Smart Gurukul

> Smart Gurukul (smartgurukul.org) is an AI-powered, gamified school app for Indian K-12 schools. It combines three things in one mobile app: AI (an AI Helpdesk that answers school-data questions in English, Hindi or Hinglish, and an Academic Helper for teaching notes, lesson plans and student doubts), school operations (GPS-geofenced staff attendance with no hardware, class attendance, fees, payroll, exams, report cards, chat and video calls), and games (XP, daily streaks, weekly leagues, House Wars, live Battle Room quizzes and 1v1 Arena challenges). It serves principals/admins, teachers, students and parents, and is built for private budget-to-mid-fee CBSE and State Board schools across India, including school groups.

Key facts:
- Brand: Smart Gurukul (the app shows "Gurukul"). Website: https://smartgurukul.org. Contact: sales@smartgurukul.org. Instagram: @smart__gurukul.
- Positioning: "AI + School + Games". Unlike a traditional school ERP, which is an office record-keeping tool, Smart Gurukul is designed so teachers, students and parents use it daily.
- Attendance: staff mark attendance from their own phone; the server checks the phone's GPS position against the school's geofence (100 m radius by default). No biometric machine is needed. Existing RFID/fingerprint/face devices can connect through an attendance device API (integration set up per school).
- AI Helpdesk: admins ask in plain language (e.g. "how many students haven't paid fees?", a teacher's attendance percentage, unpaid salaries, enrolment) and get answers from live school data. It uses a fixed set of vetted, school-scoped lookups, not free-form database queries. Replies in the language of the question: English, Hindi or Hinglish.
- Academic Helper: AI teaching assistant for teachers (teaching notes, lesson plans, following CBSE/NCERT or a State Board pattern) and an AI tutor for students.
- Gamification: one XP score earned from attendance, assessment results, quiz wins, teacher-awarded participation and streak bonuses. It drives daily streaks, weekly leagues (Bronze up to Gurukul Master), and House Wars. Battle Room is a live group quiz scored on speed; Gurukul Arena is an asynchronous 1v1 quiz challenge using teacher-written questions.
- Parents: the same app with a parent login; one login covers all their children, with attendance calendars, fee dues and receipts, and published report cards. Parents sign in with a one-time code.
- Languages: English and Hindi app interface.
- Onboarding: the Smart Gurukul team imports the school's existing Excel registers; teachers and parents join with invite codes and one-time login codes; schools can run a 1-month pilot.
- Pricing: per student per year, quoted after a demo.
- Platforms: Android (Google Play listing coming soon); iPhone in testing.
- Not available yet (roadmap): timetable, homework, online fee payment gateway, transport/bus tracking, SMS alerts, admission enquiries, ID cards, parent–teacher chat, report-card PDFs, badges. Not planned yet: hostel, library, inventory, statutory payroll (PF/ESI/TDS).
